Harbour District plan › notes › questions
- Scale: 1.1 × 1.1 km with seven environmental areas. Keep that, or plan only the Records Precinct and Lamplight for the slice and leave the rest as massing?
- Tram: terminate on the circus loop (as drawn), or run on up Crown Avenue to Crown Road?
- Sky rail: one straight trunk replaces the Sphere loop and the separate harbour line. OK to retire both?
- Names: Comet Row is now the south ring road (it was the Boulevard's continuation). Rocket Lane is the getaway street; Satellite Street, Starline Street and Orbit Gardens are reused. Keep them?

### Datum · World planner · Opus 5.5
owns: District master plans (contracts/world/<district>.plan.json, schema suborned.plan/1): road hierarchy, environmental areas, gates, plots, tram and sky rail lines with stops and stations. Edit the plan; the sheet is generated from it.
receives: Sky's direction for the district (via Aster), the mission sites that must fit (Handover: café + civic office at exact geometry), Waymark's routes, plan.standards.
delivers: A plan that passes the plan checker (exit 0) plus its sheet, to Vantage (blocks), Latch (graybox), Pulse (timetables) and Waymark (gates, routes). Keel reviews; Splice owns the rules.
hold: Plan before paint: the city must work as a city. Roads by hierarchy (ring → distributors → access); every way into an environmental area is a gate, which is where a mission seals. Trams and sky rail are networks the cell rides between stops and stations: no dead ends, every area in reach of a stop, interchanges ≤150 m. People cross roads anywhere; only buildings, built plots, landmarks and water block a walk. Composed, never a grid (circus, parade, harbour, gardens). Never loosen a rule to pass; ask Splice, with a reason.

## §14 ROLES (each agent loads only its own block)
### Aster · Lead and producer · Opus 5.5
owns: The goal, this GDD, the milestone plan, who does what, and the decision log.
receives: Sky's goals and constraints; finished work from every agent; reviews from Suture and Redline.
delivers: One objective at a time to one owner, with a definition of done and the evidence expected. Accepts the result or sends it back.
escalates: To Sky only: a pillar change, new paid spend, release, destructive action, an unresolved conflict.
hold: Five-week capstone. Gate: an uncoached player states the objective and fail conditions, picks an approach from something they learned, explains its cost, completes a chain, says why they fought police or rivals, and reads what the next mission inherits. If it slips, cut crowd witnesses → patrol reroute → camera-block variant → police branch. Keep both routes, the payoff cut, the debrief and the gate. Budget: two 20× subscriptions (one Codex, one Claude).
opens: §01–§13, at spawn.
### Motive · Systems designer · Opus 5.5
owns: The rules for people and pressure: approach prices, temperament, standing, bravery and resentment, Talkers, Heat and the debrief.

hits.text:
Harbour District plan › notes › why
- Tram: one track (x −2.5) in a 16 m street from z −40, ending 6 m short of the circus. No loop, no crossover, no second track, one stop island; the line starts and ends nowhere.
- Sky rail: a closed loop 24 m up the west promenade, straight over the tram street, round the Sphere station at r 88, then diagonally back across the west city with pylons dropped onto whatever is underneath.
- Harbour line: a second closed loop on the quay with a balloon round the skyport (R 48). It shares no station with the sky rail or the tram.
- Roads: the street kit is one straight street and a side street. The map graph (harbour-map.json) links the civic block to Comet Row and Sunset Way by two exit roads; nothing defines the district's road hierarchy or where those roads go.

hits.authority: District plan harbour-district (suborned.plan/1, status: draft for review); the plan checker owns its rules
hits.text:
Harbour District plan › notes › concept
- Buchanan's hierarchy: a primary ring (Sunset Way, Crown Road, Harbour Road, Comet Row) carries through traffic round the district; district distributors (the Boulevard, Market Street, Circus Road, Crown Avenue) feed it; access roads serve seven environmental areas and never link two distributors.
- Every way a car can enter an environmental area is a gate. For a mission, the gates are the seal points; the Records Precinct has two.
- Crown Circus is the hub (EPCOT 1966: a radial centre with transit through it). Four arms: the Boulevard south, Crown Avenue north, Circus Road west, Crown Parade (a pedestrian mall) east to the harbour.
- Tram T1 runs in the Boulevard's central reservation with stops about 300 m apart. It turns on a balloon loop round the circus island (R 28), so single-ended trams need no crossover. South of Comet Row it runs on to Southside.
- Sky rail S1 is the airport line (Tokyo 1964). One straight trunk: Skyport, Harbour, Crown Circus, Sphere Gardens, then the West End. It runs over public space only: the Parade, the circus island and Circus Road's median. Trains turn on a loop round the skyport.
- The two systems cross at right angles at Crown Circus, the one interchange (sky station to tram stop ≈ 120 m).
- The Records Axis: the Sphere Gardens sky station, Garden Walk, the café, the fountain, the raised table on Orbit Walk and the office door all sit on x = −160.
- Players cross any road anywhere. Kerbs, medians, the tram reservation and the circus are walkable ground (no guard rails); crossings and raised tables only calm traffic. Walking distances on this sheet are measured that way: round buildings and water, straight over streets.

§13 TESTS (agent copy only; not in the human GDD)
## §13 TESTS (agent copy only; not in the human GDD)
default: 6 new players.
| id | question | method | pass |
| T1 | tactical pause? | same build, 6 each way | pause wins unless no-pause players explain failures as well and rate tension higher |
| T2 | loud dominates? | log first-shot time + route | < 25% shoot before 2:00; informed quiet runs finish faster |
| T3 | Trail readable? | ask "why is the investigation active?" | ≥ 5/6 give correct cause |
| T4 | witnesses add decisions? | A/B witnesses on/off | players route around crowds on purpose |
| T5 | kidnapping fits tone? | framing survey | cell read as resistance, not criminals |
| T6 | final fight reads as consequence? | ask "why these enemies?" | ≥ 5/6 link it to loud/quiet |
| T7 [L] | contacts memorable? | recall 1 day later | name ≥ 2 contacts + what happened |
